name: Act Security
description: Enforce least-privilege access for humans, workloads, and AI agents in cloud environments — analyze effective IAM permissions and close the gap agents inherit from stale human roles.

skills.name: Permission Analysis
skills.description: Resolves effective IAM permissions across policies and boundaries to show what an identity can actually do.

skills.name: Policy Simulation
skills.description: Simulates whether a given principal would be allowed an action before a policy change is applied in production.

skills.name: Agent Scoping
skills.description: Narrows the permissions granted to AI agents and workloads so they stop inheriting broad human access.
